theorem sendMsgs_log [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms : List Msg) :
    (sendMsgs s0 ms).log = s0.log

theorem sendMsgs_logst [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms : List Msg) :
    (sendMsgs s0 ms).logst = s0.logst

theorem sendMsgs_app [GoGlobalContext] [GoSemanticsFunctions] (s0 : NState) (ms1 ms2 : List Msg) :
    sendMsgs (sendMsgs s0 ms1) ms2 = sendMsgs s0 (ms1 ++ ms2)

theorem perm_id_cons (cfg : GSet w64) (id : w64) (xs : List w64) (Hid : id ∈ cfg) (Hnd : xs.Nodup)
    (Hmem : ∀ (z : w64), z ∈ xs ↔ z ∈ cfg) : xs.Perm (id :: elements (cfg \ {id}))
